outlet: Office of the Governor news release, "Governor Ferguson appoints Tyson R. Hill to Court of Appeals, Division III" (2025-11-19)
notes: Appointment effective Jan. 1, 2026, filling Judge George Fearing's seat on his retirement; Hill's career (Grant County Superior Court since 2021, more than seven years on Grant County District Court, therapeutic drug court, lead appellate attorney in the Grant County Prosecutor's Office, clerk to Justice James M. Johnson).
